column4: oa-llp: the mathematical clause "the full C*-algebra of such a group cannot have the local lifting property [p. 527]" is the closed endpoint printedOzawaNoLocalLiftingGeneral (0e6bc6f50), for every infinite simple hyperlinear group with property (T). Route: Ozawa p. 24 and p. 527, i.e. local ucp lifts, Arveson extension (bacdfad19), matrix models (oa-mcduff 24a27e527), and Kirchberg Thm 1.1 (oa-kirchberg 9df1daac4). "Ozawa stated the hyperlinear form in 2003" and "Pestov's Open question 9.1 adds the sofic form" are credit. Text verified verbatim at tip 8b36733d7, l.51-54; the census on origin is at 696c4b602. Modules are wire-queued.

oa-llp: credit for names ("named by Radulescu", "introduced by Gromov and named by Weiss"). No mathematical claim. The notions are IsHyperlinear (Sofic/Hyperlinear) and IsSofic. Verbatim at 8b36733d7, l.94-96 (census 9cb80166d).

oa-llp: reports what Pestov and Kwiatkowska wrote about the state of the literature, which is provenance and credit. The note's own answer to the question it mentions is thm:main (hyperlinear simple Kazhdan groups). Verbatim at 8b36733d7, l.99-102 (census 9cb80166d).

oa-llp: "The proof works for other actions" asserts thm:general: minimal, topologically free actions of finitely generated groups on Cantor sets, with matricial finite models. It is carried by the closed printedSimpleKazhdanGeneral (SimpleKazhdanGeneralClosed, #audit_closed_axioms), and thm:main follows by printedSimpleKazhdanSoficMain_of_general (MainFromGeneral). Both modules are on origin and wire-queued. Verbatim at 8b36733d7, l.104 (census 9cb80166d).

oa-llp: "no nontrivial element fixes a nonempty open set" is IsTopologicallyFreeAction Λ Z := ∀ ξ ≠ 1, ∀ U open, U.Nonempty → ∃ x ∈ U, ξ • x ≠ x (LamplighterAction). PrintedSimpleKazhdanGeneral uses the same clause inline as its topological-freeness hypothesis. The Lean definition is stated for any topological space, which covers the printed Cantor sets. Verbatim at 8b36733d7, l.104-105 (census 9cb80166d).

oa-llp: e_ij(r) = I_n + r E_ij is elementaryUnit i j h r, whose value is 1 + Matrix.single i j r for i ≠ j (Matrix.single i j r = r E_ij). elementaryGroup is the subgroup they generate, EL_n. Leavitt/ElementaryGroup is root-imported. Verbatim at 8b36733d7, l.105-107 (census 9cb80166d).
